summary: Senior Mobile Engineer with 5+ years of experience building and scaling production-grade mobile applications used by tens of millions of users.
Strong expertise in React Native and Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile (KMM), specializing in payment systems, real-time transaction flows, and wearable platforms (WearOS, watchOS).
Proven ability to lead critical modules, design clean and modular architectures, and collaborate cross-functionally to deliver secure, high-performance features in large-scale Super App ecosystems.
objective: To grow into a Mobile Tech Lead or Project Manager role, focusing on mobile architecture, cross-platform solutions, and high-impact payment systems, while contributing to scalable products and mentoring junior engineers in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment.

workExperience.title: Senior Mobile App Developer
responsibilities: Architected and developed a cross-platform payment solution for wearable devices (Apple Watch, WearOS, Huawei, Garmin), enabling QR-based transactions and secure authentication using native payment APIs (Apple Pay, Google Pay).
Led the Transaction Result module, improving reliability and user experience by implementing real-time transaction status updates via MQTT.
Led development of the FinancialHub mini-app, a centralized entry point for personal finance features including bank linking, insurance, and investments.
PayX: Migrated multiple payment mini-apps from React Native to native Android/iOS using Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile (KMM), unifying business logic and reducing feature inconsistency across platforms.
Enhanced and maintained core mini-apps: Payment, Cash In/Out, Bank Linking, Account Management, and Transaction Result.
Established real-time performance monitoring with Grafana dashboards, tracking startup time, error rate, and JS thread performance to proactively improve app stability.
Collaborated closely with backend, product, QA, and UI/UX teams in an Agile environment to deliver high-impact features for millions of users.
